mentl/54b13d2:
`mentl <file>:<line>` read the source slice by (file, line) and the graph
node by line ALONE, over a span index holding every node in the link. Each
module's spans are its own 1-based coordinates, so every module in the weave
holds an entry for every line number it reaches and the three-case line
rule's widest-node pick answered with a stranger. Measured across three
files at one line: src/synth_proposer.mn:733 rendered scan_number's type,
effects, ownership and Lede from src/lexer.mn, and its own Why line said
"at synth_proposer:733". Every aspect agreed with itself, which is what made
it unnoticeable.

The fix is a read of a fact the graph already stamps. collect_module_cells
iterates i over the NModule nodes and was discarding the handle that i IS —
the defect driver_module_ast's comment already confessed. The cell carries
its handle now (thirteen destructures, one coordinated edit),
module_handle_of_path is its first consumer, and the address narrows the
span index to the addressed module once, before the line rule runs.

Two things the build found. The module node is an entry in its own span
index and its span is the whole file, so with the strangers gone it won the
covering case at every line no decl reaches; it is excluded, and the
whole-file reading keeps its own spelling (`mentl <file>:0`).
module_path_of_span answers module-of-a-span by containment, which stopped
being reliable at the same moment; its one handle-holding reader is
converted and the span-taking rest are banked.

Save/Copy buttons in the veil export full sound state as JSON (all 35

Fix PolySynth voice leak: triggerRelease(note) on a 2-voice PolySynth
only releases the last-allocated voice. If the same note retriggers
before the prior voice finishes its release tail, the old voice orphans
and sustains forever. releaseAll() catches every internal voice since
each sign only plays one note.
